title: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-Training for Open-Set Object Detection
layout_note: Overview panel on the left half, two detail panels stacked on the right half; each panel is titled by a numbered purple pill ('1. Model Overall', '2. A Feature Enhancer Layer', '3. A Decoder Layer'). In the overview, a text branch (left) and an image branch (right) rise in parallel from the inputs at the bottom, merge through a fusion block and continue upward to the outputs and losses.
grouping: Panels are split by solid purple rules (one vertical, one horizontal). Each detail panel is linked to its block in the overview by a wide pale translucent wedge fanning from the block's edge to the panel's container, which repeats the block's fill.
shapes_depth: Text features are rows of slanted thin 3-D rods (pale green-yellow) and image features are dark blue 3-D cubes with a grid; queries are short yellow 3-D rods. Fusion blocks have a horizontal gradient fill from pale green (text side) to blue (image side); the decoder block is solid yellow. Backbones are a green rectangle (text) and a blue trapezoid (image). The input text is a rounded pill in typewriter font ('cat . person . mouse .') with a faded second prompt behind it; the input image is a photo with a faded copy behind. Outputs are tiny box crops of the photo; losses are red arrows rising to labels at the top. The contrastive objective is a grid whose header column is the input text in rotated typewriter letters, with '1' in matching cells. Attention boxes mark K,V and Q at their inputs.
proposed_highlight: The modality-fusion blocks are told apart by the green-to-blue gradient fill, the visual mix of the two modality colours; each is expanded in a detail panel joined to it by a translucent zoom wedge.
lesson: Encode the two modalities as two glyph types and colours (text = row of thin green rods, image = blue grid cube) and fill every block that fuses them with a green-to-blue gradient, so fusion is visible without labels.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2303.05499); venue ECCV as recorded from Semantic Scholar, the venue's year not verified.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: text (left) and image (right) columns rise bottom to top and meet in blocks filled with a green-to-blue gradient (Feature Enhancer, Language-guide Query Selection) and then in the Cross-Modality Decoder

relations.form: in '1. Model Overall', Input Text -> Text Backbone -> green bar-glyph features on the left and Input Image -> trapezoid Image Backbone -> blue cube features on the right, both reading bottom to top
the full-width Feature Enhancer bar spans both columns with a green-to-blue gradient; the decoder takes text features as Keys & Values from the side and cross-modality queries from below
pale beige wedges tie the Feature Enhancer to '2. A Feature Enhancer Layer' (bottom right) and the decoder to '3. A Decoder Layer' (top right), each panel stacked at the same height as its block

at the top, model outputs (query sticks and image thumbnails) form rows of a grid whose columns are the prompt tokens 'cat . person . mouse .', with 1s marking matches; red arrows lead to Contrastive loss and Localization loss
inside each zoom panel, attention sublayers stack bottom to top with Q and K,V labels on the short arrows between them

channels.colour: green = text side, blue = image side, a green-to-blue gradient = a block mixing both; yellow = cross-modality queries/decoder; red = loss arrows; purple = panel titles and rules
channels.shape: slanted bar rows = text features, 3D voxel cubes = image features, yellow sticks = queries, trapezoid = image backbone, rounded rectangles = modules
channels.line: black arrows = data flow; red arrows = losses; beige wedges = zoom ties; a small hop where skip lines cross
channels.frame: purple pill-titled panels separated by purple rules; the zoomed layers have a coloured outer frame

quality.strengths: The two modalities are colour-coded consistently from features to modules, and the gradient fill turns 'this block mixes text and image' into colour; representations (text bars, image cubes, query sticks) are drawn between every module; zoom panels sit beside the block they open, at its height, tied by wedges.
quality.weaknesses: Text-feature skip lines leave the left column, loop round with a hop and cross other wires to reach Query Selection and the decoder; the contrastive grid at the top is small and partly occluded by a rotated sentence label, so the pairing that defines the loss is hard to read.

insights.structure: A purple vertical rule splits the figure: '1. Model Overall' fills the left half, and the right half stacks zoom-ins '3. A Decoder Layer' (top) and '2. A Feature Enhancer Layer' (bottom), each tied to its block on the left by a pale beige wedge.
insights.data: Text features are rows of slanted green bars, image features are blue 3D voxel cubes, queries are small yellow sticks, and outputs feed a contrastive grid with text tokens as columns.
insights.emphasis: Blocks carry a green-to-blue gradient fill (Feature Enhancer, Query Selection, enhancer layer frame) encoding text-image mixing, and the two losses exit as red arrows at the top.
insights.flow: Bottom to top in the overall model from input text and image to losses; zoom wedges run right to the detailed layers, which also read bottom to top.
insights.avoid: Text-feature skip lines loop around the left side and cross with a hop, making the routing to Query Selection and the decoder hard to trace.

arrangement.units: three numbered panels with purple pill titles, separated by purple rules: overall model on the left, two layer zoom-ins stacked on the right
arrangement.inputs_as: a quoted category prompt pill and a real cat photo
arrangement.losses_at: top of the overall panel: Contrastive loss and Localization loss with red arrows
arrangement.shared: beige zoom wedges connect blocks to their detail panels
